name: Hero in Motion
authorship: Original example data, scripts, tests, guides and illustrations created for this repository.

assets.origin: Original SVG poster drawn with code for this repository (northern lights over a lake, for the fictional brand Lantern Lake Cabins), labelled as a fictional example; illustration, not a photograph. film/explainer.html animates its layers into the example's video.
Spanish copy of examples/poster.svg with a translated title, description and label; original illustration drawn with code.
Original SVG poster drawn with code for this repository (a child floating in a pool, seen from above, for the fictional brand Saltline Swim School); illustration, not a photograph.
Original SVG poster drawn with code for this repository (a lit studio window in a night city, for the fictional brand Late Window Radio); illustration, not a photograph.
Original source-authored SVG diagram; illustration, not a rendered film frame or photograph.
Original source-authored page over examples/poster.svg; docs/social-card.png is a 1280 x 640 screenshot of it.
Original source-authored canvas animation; draws an illustration of the kit's page, not a screen recording.

Rendered from film/explainer.html by scripts/render_film.py (--format square --lang en); procedural, no AI video model, no third-party footage; the soundtrack is synthesised by scripts/score_film.py from the film's cues, no samples or third-party audio.
The final frame (the end card) of media/hero-in-motion-demo.mp4, rendered as a still by scripts/render_film.py (--format square --lang en --still 15.9667).

The Lantern Lake example's own 10-second clip, rendered from film/explainer.html by scripts/render_film.py (--format clip); the WebM is a VP9 copy of the same frames. Procedural, no AI video model, no third-party footage, silent.

The two extra examples' 10-second clips, rendered from examples/poster-swim.svg and examples/poster-radio.svg by scripts/render_film.py (--format clip --poster), then re-encoded where needed to pass scripts/inspect_media.py --check. Procedural, no AI video model, no third-party footage, silent.
Built by scripts/build_demo.py from examples/ and templates/demo/; the posters are copies of the ones in examples/.

example_data: examples/hero.json and examples/hero.es.json are fictional homepage examples for a made-up brand, Lantern Lake Cabins; examples/swim.json (Saltline Swim School) and examples/radio.json (Late Window Radio) are two more made-up brands. Each example's video is a clip of its own poster, drawn with code (docs/).
generated_media: The sample film in media/ and the examples' clips in docs/, all rendered by this repository's own scripts/render_film.py from film/explainer.html and film/poster-clip.html.
external_dependencies: Optional: an already-installed ffprobe for scripts/inspect_media.py. The kit never downloads it.
Optional: Playwright for Python with Chromium and FFmpeg, for scripts/render_film.py and tests/test_browser.py; Playwright alone for scripts/measure_page.py. The kit never installs them.
network_access: none (scripts/measure_page.py serves the page's folder to 127.0.0.1 only)
